objective: Test the exact P1 V5 claim that its hidden evaluator machine-verifies heterogeneous intervention rescue rather than merely checking oracle-derived repair identity.
finding: V5 evaluate_intervention derives rescue from required_root_repairs subset repair_targets, where required_root_repairs is generated from the hidden oracle. It does not replay trajectory state, recompute dependency propagation, or verify that the declared terminal failed resource becomes valid.
affected_claims_if_independently_verifie: P1_TYPED_INTERVENTION_ENVELOPE_V5 heterogenous intervention rescue claim must be narrowed or superseded
P1 V5 terminal-scope transport must not count P1_HETEROGENEOUS_INTERVENTION_RESCUE as discharged
P1 V5 direct-surface scope-superset composition must not lift quarantine from V5 rescue labels
required_correction: Implement an independent forward post-intervention trajectory evaluator that applies repairs to causal faults, propagates dependency/resource validity, and declares rescue only when the terminal failed resource is recomputed valid; symptom-only and incomplete repairs must fail by the state transition semantics rather than by expected-label comparison.
